channel.title: Research thrusts | CODAC
channel.description: The five intertwined research thrusts of the DIGICAMS center.

item.title: Computational Sheaf Theory
item.description: Thrust 1: abstractions and algorithms in computational sheaf theory, general enough to span optimization, dynamics, and control, concrete enough to implement.

item.title: Learning and Control for Open Systems
item.description: Thrust 2: composite energy-driven systems, spanning learning systems that optimize objectives and dynamical systems that obey classical mechanics.

item.title: Compositional Optimization Algorithms
item.description: Thrust 3: cellular sheaves and homological programs for decentralized optimization under impaired, asynchronous communication.

item.title: Context-Aware Decisions Under Uncertainty
item.description: Thrust 4: Moore machine formulations of POMDPs and stochastic games, and policies robust to several kinds of uncertainty at once.

item.title: Scalable Implementation and Deployment
item.description: Thrust 5: a user-facing platform and domain-specific languages that put the center's methods in the hands of practicing engineers.
